text.p: A total of 7.5 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Wednesday at an average 2,694 roubles ($0.48) a share, down from 2,802 roubles at the previous auction on February 5, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 291.25 million shares, equivalent to 1.23 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6, 1996. Prices reached a record average 3,015.78 roubles at the auction on October 21, 1996.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.

The next auction will be held on February 19, when 7.5 million shares in 30 lots will be offered at price not exceeding 2,400 roubles a share. Further auctions will be held on February 26, March 5 and 12.
